subject: Post-event credit redistribution & reconciliation
messages:
From: Carol Jensen <c.jensen@blackwoodhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+billing@blackwoodhealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Request: reallocate unused post-event credits

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for sponsoring our 'Digital Care in Primary Clinics' session last week — turnout was solid and your team's pre-demo was well received. We ran into one operational snag on our end: a block of promo codes issued to registrants (50 codes, 1,000 token credits each) went mostly unused because several attendees missed the live session and never activated them.

We'd like to request either:
- Redistributing the unused credits to a curated list of prospects who attended other sessions, OR
- Converting them into extended trial credits attached to enterprise prospects (valid for 90 days).

Attached is a short CSV listing the unredeemed codes and counts (blackwood_unredeemed_codes.csv). Can Redwood confirm the redistribution process, any limits on reissuing codes, and whether you need a PO or formal approval on our side?

Goal: reassign/reissue by end of next week (12/19). Please let me know what's required from our ops or billing team.

Warmly,
Carol Jensen
Head of Partnerships | Blackwood Health
carol.jensen@blackwoodhealth.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Carol Jensen <c.jensen@blackwoodhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: reallocate unused post-event credits

Hi Carol — thanks for the low-friction write-up and the CSV.

We can support both options you outlined but need to lock operational constraints and an approval cap. Proposed approach:

1) Split the pool 50/50: half as reissued single-use promo codes for outreach, half as extended trial credits (90 days) assigned to specific enterprise prospects.
2) Sales ops (Ben) to validate recipient list and ensure no double-dipping.
3) Ops pushes codes and we confirm delivery + redemption window.

I've attached a quick proposal sheet with the recommended allocation and timeline (proposal_reallocation_ava_v1.xlsx). If agreeable, please confirm approval and whether we should route a small PO or just an email authorization.

If you prefer a different split, say 70/30 in favor of reissue for lead-gen, note that in your reply and we can update.

I'll ping Marissa for any budget-level sign-off and ask Ben to prepare the reissue matrix.

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Carol Jensen <c.jensen@blackwoodhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 12:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: reallocate unused post-event credits

Thanks for the clear plan, Ava. I'm comfortable approving up to $5k in redistributed credits for Blackwood as a one-off to support the post-event nurture — assuming we re-attach a 90-day redemption window for the trial portion and we get an explicit recipient list.

Couple of constraints:
- No reissue to customers who already received enterprise credits in Q3-Q4 (ops will flag duplicates).
- Reissued promo codes should be single-use and tracked by recipient email.

@Ben / @Sean, please confirm that tracking and push logistics are feasible by 12/16 so Carol's team can start outreach on 12/17.

Marissa
VP, Growth | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Carol Jensen <c.jensen@blackwoodhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: reallocate unused post-event credits

All right — ops has reviewed the CSV and the proposal. We can execute the 50/50 split Ava suggested and track everything in our reissue registry. Deliverables and timeline:

- I'll generate new single-use promo codes for the reissue pool (25 codes x 1,000 tokens) and map them to the recipient emails you provide.
- The other 25 codes will be converted to extended-trial allocations; we'll assign those to named enterprise prospects and set a 90-day redemption window.
- Attachments: blackwood_credit_report_dec2026.csv (breakdown), approved_reallocation_sheet.xlsx (final allocation template).

Requirements from Blackwood to proceed:
1) Final recipient list for the 25 reissue codes (email + full name).
2) Confirmation of which enterprise prospects should receive the trial-extended allocations (company + POC email).
3) Written approval from Blackwood (email reply here is fine).

Ops will schedule the push for 12/16 (codes emailed from ops@redwood.com). If we get the lists by EOD 12/14 we can meet that schedule.

—Ben
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Carol Jensen <c.jensen@blackwoodhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ops+billing@blackwoodhealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: reallocate unused post-event credits

Thanks, Ben — that works for us.

Attached in this reply is the recipient list for the 25 reissue codes (we pared to the highest-intent prospects) and the enterprise prospect list for the 90-day trial allocations. Carol has signed approval in the attached confirmation email from our procurement alias.

One ask: can you add a short note in the redemption email that the code came via Blackwood's event partnership with Redwood? That helps our outreach conversion.

If you need the PO, ops+billing@blackwoodhealth.com will issue it this afternoon; otherwise this email thread serves as written authorization.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please confirm when the codes are in the registry and when we can expect the outbound.

Warmly,
Carol
Head of Partnerships | Blackwood Health
